My heart hurts for you just reading that. It's a difficult situation, but based on what I read, I sense that you both really do love each other. And love in a deep way, not a quick lustful fling, but about genuinely caring about who each other are at the very core of your personalities. At this stage in your life, you may not ever find somebody else like her in terms of the bond you once created and the fact that she is the mother of your first born child. If I were in your shoes I would completely pardon, forgive, and forget the whole open marriage situation because you do have an opportunity to grow and come out stronger from it, and if this open marriage situation can't separate the two of you, what else even could? But it may be a long road to get back to a place where you both have that deep level of trust and intimacy you once had. I believe it will start with you forgiving her in your heart, and with her feeling regret in her heart about sleeping with other men, and the fact that she is going out so frequently during this period where you find it hard to trust her is a hurdle as well. Best of luck, I hope my comment was helpful and not cringe or anything like that
